text: We ordered our food, and while the staff were fast with getting it out, my wrap was practically disassembled. Some random man also decided he would sit directly across from me and my partner who made us extremely uncomfortable while we were trying to finish our food. I was confused by the sign saying don't feed the birds because the doors of the place were automatically closing and there were no birds in the store which honestly if there were birds it would've at least made the experience fun. One of the light globes was missing from above our table, at no point did I see anybody cleaning the dining area, and not one single smile from any of the staff. Very disappointed, will not be coming again.
author: Ayla Bain

text: The manager here is really rude, please consider hiring a new one. I asked for one of the collector cups, specifically the shrek design, and he looked so disgusted with me. He proceeded to say I was forbidden access to a cup unless I bought a meal. Which is false. I then went to the Maccas inside myer centre and the lovely people there (including the manager) sold the cups to me without a meal, because it's literally allowed. Shoutout to Finley you're a real one. So I don't know why this rundle mall east manager is acting like he is running a high security, exclusive establishment. It's quite frankly embarrassing. Hope he doesn't get tickets to Shrek 5 in 2026.
author: hayley

text:
Ordered via the app and went to the store, the staff checked my phone for the order, looking puzzled, and directed me to another branch that had already closed to pick up my meal. After reconfirming the address and inquiring again, the manager surprisingly told me that my order had been given to someone else, and they needed to remake it. After the remake, the rude staff member said, “Take it,” but upon inspection, I realized one item was missing.

Throughout the entire ordeal, neither the staff nor the manager offered any apologies for their series of mistakes, displaying a complete lack of professionalism in their service💩
author: Tiffany Chiu

text: The toilet was out of order, with three children this was really annoying. How long has this toilet been out of order? When I called to complain, the manager hung up on me as soon as I said the word complaint. When I tried to call back, the line was busy. It has been busy now for 50 minutes and I suspect he has deliberately taken the phone off the hook. ( When I first called, it took ages for the phone to be answered, so it was not a busy time ) Why doesn't this manager want to hear complaints?
author: Strawberry Pickles

text: Hands down the worst maccas I've ever been to! Every table was sticky and gross none were cleaned off after customers had left, waited forever for our food and they got the order wrong, tried the new arch burger and it was dripping in grease and tasted foul! I don't have a single nice thing to say about this place they need health inspections and a change of management because the staff was just downright rude and careless!
author: Nikita Penhall

text: Worst McDonald’s I’ve ever been to. Take away orders only. The staff were doing no work and were just chatting behind the counter. I ordered an iced coffee and waited a huge amount of time. When I asked where my drink was she rudely told me it was already made, they never called my number out. I hated this McDonald’s and will never go back.

text:
Absolutely shocking customer service and below par food...even for McDonald's. Not only could they not get a simple breakfast order correct, the "fixed" order was done with obvious resentment and still wasn't right (making a Mighty McMuffin should be pretty simple).
If you fancy a quick breakfast, grab it from Hubgry Jacks across the road.
author: Craig Padfield

text: Pointless. The store wasn’t busy. Myself and other customers were waiting to order, but staff behind the counter made no effort to acknowledge us, let alone take an order. They just continued to chat amongst themselves in the kitchen. I left after 10 mins of waiting by the counter where staff members did not come forward to take an order.
author: Adam Connell

text: The worst slowest service out! It took 15 minutes to get my basic order of a bacon and egg mc muffin and 2 hash browns on Sunday morning. Only a few customers there, but the staff, what there were of them, were going at a very slow pace, especially an indian girl who didnt seem to knoe what she was doing.
author: Mardi Read
